Hi Marissa — thanks again for the demos last week. We're excited to move forward (legal has seen the order form) but a couple of items came up on our side around the publicity bits in the MSA/order form.

Specifically:
- Our marketing team would like to do a short case study but we cannot appear in press releases or have our logo used without a separate approval process.
- We can consider an anonymized case study (no company name, industry descriptor only) and a customer quote, provided:
  - The quote is approved by Stellar Health in writing before publication.
  - No logos or trademarks are used.
  - Any press release is embargoed for 14 days and Stellar has the right to request redaction.

Daniel (cc) is our legal lead — he'll handle redlines. Can you send your preferred language for an anonymized/quote-only exception so our counsel can compare to our standard? Also attaching our standard publicity consent form for reference.

Thanks — Elena

[Attachment: stellar_publicity_policy.xlsx (Spreadsheet)]

Subject: Re: Anonymized case study conversation / MSA publicity clause

Elena — great to hear. Appreciate the constraints — we're happy to accommodate an anonymized case study and a controlled quote. Below is the language we typically propose (short form) that keeps things operational:

--- Proposed publicity clause (Redwood) ---
1) Case studies and quotes: Customer grants Redwood the right to publish an anonymized case study and to publish a short customer quote, provided that Redwood does not use Customer's legal name, logo, or trademark without prior written approval. Any proposed quote or case study text will be provided to Customer for written approval at least fourteen (14) days prior to publication. Customer may request redaction or withholding of the quote or case study; Redwood will not unreasonably withhold publication for legitimate business reasons.
2) Embargo: Redwood will respect a reasonable embargo period not to exceed thirty (30) days unless otherwise agreed in writing.
3) Aggregated metrics: Redwood may publish aggregated, non-identifying metrics derived from Customer's use of the Service.

--- end ---

I've attached a redline of the MSA highlighting the publicity section and a proposed order form note that marks 'anonymized case study allowed, no logos'. If that looks acceptable to your legal team, we'll prepare the DocuSign packet. If Daniel has edits, happy to take them.

Attachments: redlined_MSA_stellar_v2.docx (MS Word), orderform_stellar_redline.pdf (PDF)

Best,

Team — forwarding Elena's note and our proposed language. A couple of operational asks: 

1) Legal sign-off: can we accept the "no logos / name only with approval" framing? Dev — you mentioned in last call we sometimes need a further carveout for reference calls (i.e., exclude from 'no name' if the customer agrees to be a reference). Suggest we explicitly allow reference calls only if Stellar signs off in writing.
2) Marketing: Karthik, should we offer a brief launch credit (one month of free dedicated capacity) in exchange for a quote approval? Could help expedite sign-off.
3) Timing: Elena asked for at least 14 days for quote approval; our standard is 7. Leaning to accept 14 to be cordial.

If legal wants to tighten "unreasonably withhold" language, propose we replace it with ""notwithstanding Customer's right to withhold approval for legitimate confidentiality reasons" — simpler.

Thoughts? I'll loop Dev into the redline session with Daniel if needed.

--
Marissa

We have attached a countersigned PDF of the MSA with the publicity clause updated per that sentence, and an updated order form that includes the anonymized case study field. We're prepared to sign via DocuSign — please send the envelope link.
